messages:
incident-bot: PAGE FIRED -> service=rate-limiter-prod severity=critical summary="Unexpected 429 spike in us-west-2" incident=PD12345 https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD12345

pagerduty: Auto-escalation: paging SRE oncall and infra lead. Escalation level: 2.

sara (oncall): acked. I'm on it.

sara (oncall): quick skim of metrics: sudden jump in 429s at ~2026-03-14T12:02:13Z across multiple tenants in us-west-2. Errors look like quota enforcement, not backend 5xxs.

mike (eng-sre): can you paste a sample log line?

sara (oncall): grabbing one now from quota-mapper logs:
```
2026-03-14T12:02:15.123Z quota-mapper INFO tenant=acct-42 request_id=abc123 applied_quota=0 expected_quota=1000 decision=throttle status=429
```

sara (oncall): hmm applied_quota=0 across many tenants. We rolled out quota-mapper-v2 config at 11:59 UTC.

mike (eng-sre): that rollout overlaps with the timing. looks like the mapping table returned zero for some namespaces. tagging as possible config bug.

raj (infra): paging command suggestion: if mapping is bad, we can route traffic to legacy limiter. Running: `kubectl patch svc rate-limiter -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"version":"legacy"}}}'` to steer traffic. Want me to run?

sara (oncall): please run fallback routing. Doing a quick attempt to rollback the flag: `/ops/feature_flag rollback quota-mapper-v2`

deploy-bot: Rollback started for feature flag quota-mapper-v2 by sara (oncall). Job id: RBK-7782.

raj (infra): patch applied, routing switched to legacy limiter in us-west-2.

sara (oncall): monitoring... 429 rate dropping. Past minute: 429s dropped from ~1800/min to ~150/min. Still tailing.

mike (eng-sre): opened internal issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/incidents/issues/589 - root suspect: fallback mapping returning empty bucket for tenant id modulo calculation. Adding logs.

emma (cust-succ): starting customer outreach for impacted accounts: acct-42, acct-197, acct-orto. Posting to status.redwood.ai draft: "We experienced elevated request throttling impacting text generation in us-west-2 between 12:02–12:58 UTC. Mitigation applied. Engineers investigating root cause." Want me to publish?

sara (oncall): hold off 5m until we confirm fully recovered.

pagerduty: Incident PD12345 acknowledged by sara (oncall) at 2026-03-14T12:04:01Z.

sara (oncall): full rollback completed, the feature flag is back to previous state. Watching token rates and error budget.

mike (eng-sre): quick reproducer: locally, when mapping table has empty rows, fallback code does `capacity = rows[i-1]` which becomes undefined when i==0. Fix in branch `fix/quota-mapper-offbyone`.

raj (infra): can we add a canary gate to the feature flag so mapping table size is validated before full rollout? I'll add a pre-flight check in the packaging pipeline.

sara (oncall): 429s are back to baseline. Confirming no lingering customer 429s reported in logs for last 10m.

emma (cust-succ): publishing status update now with root-cause pending. Notifying effected customers directly.

mike (eng-sre): creating PR for hotfix and unit tests, will request review from raj and sara. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/quota-mapper/pull/234

sara (oncall): switching incident state: mitigation applied, routing fallback + rollback completed. Moving to monitoring. I'll hand off to mike for postmortem.

sara (oncall): oncall handoff: mike (eng-sre) taking primary follow-up at 13:00 UTC.

mike (eng-sre): ack. I'll own the post-incident actions: add canary checks, validate mapping table generation, add defensive default capacity, and improve alerting to include mapping-table health.

sara (oncall): closing PD after confirmation. Incident duration ~56m.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED -> PD12345 resolved by sara (oncall) at 2026-03-14T12:58:39Z. Summary: Bad quota-mapper rollout (off-by-one fallback) caused applied_quota=0 for many tenants resulting in widespread 429s. Mitigation: rollback feature flag + route to legacy limiter. Next steps: hotfix PR, canary gating, targeted customer follow-ups.

emma (cust-succ): adding notes to customer tickets and follow-ups scheduled.

mike (eng-sre): will put a short incident writeup in the incidents repo and schedule a 30m blameless postmortem this week.

sara (oncall): thanks everyone for quick response. :thumbsup:
